title: Motion
description: full = a held key's underline fades as it is released, a new peak lights amber for a moment, the readout eases in on the results screen. reduced = values and enter/exit still ease; key lights and the peak flash snap. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps small text readable on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = text straight on the game with a contrast shadow; only for a dimmed background.

title: Keys per second
description: osu!mania only: live and peak keys per second over the caps (the same number as kps-graph, which owns it in mania). In osu!, taiko and catch key-counter is where keys per second lives and always shows it.

title: Orientation
description: auto follows the page's shape: a row of key caps in a wide box, a column of keys in a tall one. Resize the browser source / vosulay page / renderer layer and the layout re-flows.

title: Alignment
description: Which side of the box the keys hug when they do not fill it. right mirrors the row (the readout on the left of the caps; key labels on the right in a column) for pages on the right side of the screen.

title: Show KPS history
description: Bars of keys per second over the last 10 s beside the readout, where the box has room for them (taiko's row, wider pages); on the results screen, the whole attempt with its peak bright.

title: Show total presses
description: Sum of all key presses this attempt, where the box has room for it (taiko's row, the mania strip, wider pages).

title: Mania cap widths
description: skin: caps take the current skin's ColumnWidth / ColumnSpacing proportions (read through vosu), so a page as wide as the stage lines up with its columns. equal: same width for every key.
